componentIds.rule: The id segment after the colon must exactly match the source filename without extension.

files.rule: All four files are required. A folder missing any of them is incomplete and the component is not fully governed.

exports.pattern: PascalCase named exports; no default exports
exports.variantHelper: {camelName}Variants for cva helpers, e.g. buttonVariants, badgeVariants, aiActionVariants

tokens.pattern: --{role} as an HSL triplet, consumed through a Tailwind semantic utility
tokens.rule: CSS variables hold bare HSL channel values (e.g. 222.2 47.4% 11.2%), never a full color function. Tailwind wraps them with hsl(var(--token)).
tokens.aiPrefix: AI-namespace tokens are prefixed --ai-* and defined alongside the base scale in src/index.css

forbidden: Inventing token names not present in src/index.css
Inventing prop or variant names not present in the component's .agent.json
Renaming a shadcn export to a project-specific alias
